info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Human Resource Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Travel Expenses Management API allows users to efficiently update and manage travel expense records within the Human Resource Management system. This endpoint enables modifications to specific expense entries identified by a parameter, facilitating accurate tracking and adjustment of employee travel expenses. Typical consumers include HR personnel and finance teams who need to maintain up-to-date records for reporting and reimbursement purposes. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their expense management process, ensuring compliance and clarity in travel-related expenditures.

patch.summary: Update travel expenses for a specific resource.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the travel expenses associated with a specific resource identified by RES-100045. You can modify various details related to the expense records, enabling effective expense management for resource utilization.
